content.title: How to watch Pirates vs. Cubs: TV channel and streaming options for April 12
content.text: The Pittsburgh Pirates will look for Oneil Cruz to continue a 10-game hitting streak versus the Chicago Cubs, on Sunday at 2:20 p.m. ET, at Wrigley Field. Jameson Taillon (0-1, 2.53 ERA) will start for the Cubs, who are 6-8 this season and fifth in the NL Central. Bubba Chandler (0-1, 3.12 ERA) is the expected starter for the Pirates, who are 9-5 and first in the NL Central.How to watch Pittsburgh Pirates vs. Chicago Cubs Venue: Wrigley Field Time: 2:20 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: MARQ and SportsNet PT Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. Pirates vs. Cubs odds Favorite Moneyline: Cubs -130 Underdog Moneyline: Pirates +110 Total: 12.5 Total Over Odds: -102 Total Under Odds: -118 Odds provided by BetMGM.Injury reportsCubsMatthew Boyd: 15 Day IL (Biceps), Porter Hodge: 15 Day IL (Elbow), Jordan Wicks: 15 Day IL (Forearm), Cade Horton: 15 Day IL (Forearm), Phil Maton: 15 Day IL (Knee), Justin Steele: 60 Day IL (Elbow), Shelby Miller: 60 Day IL (Elbow), Christopher Austin: 60 Day IL (Knee)PiratesJared Triolo: 10 Day IL (Knee), Jared Jones: 60 Day IL (Elbow)Stats to know Chicago’s Nico Hoerner is slashing .308/.422/.481 this season with one home run, 10 RBIs and an OPS of .903. He has a 9.4% strikeout rate and a 14.1% walk rate in 64 plate appearances, and he has scored eight total runs. Hoerner has recorded five steals on five attempts. In 55 plate appearances, Ian Happ has hit four long balls (9th in MLB), tallied seven RBIs and scored seven runs. He is batting .208/.309/.500 and has posted a 36.4% strikeout rate and a 12.7% walk rate. Cruz is hitting for a .345 BA, .400 OBP and .618 SLG with a 28.3% strikeout rate and a 6.7% walk rate. His OPS is 1.018, which ranks 10th in MLB, and he has scored 10 runs. In 60 plate appearances, he has hit four home runs (9th in MLB) and driven in 12 runs (15th in MLB). Cruz has recorded five steals on six attempts. In 58 plate appearances, Ryan O’Hearn has hit three long balls, tallied 12 RBIs (15th in MLB) and scored seven runs. He is batting .319/.414/.553 and has posted a 12.1% strikeout rate and a 15.5% walk rate.
